hardBlockPatterns_readme: These are REGEX (not plain text). Matched case-insensitively and order-independently, so the path can sit between the command and its flags.
1: rm carrying BOTH a recursive flag (-r/-R/-rf/--recursive) and a force flag (-f/--force), in any order
2: Remove-Item together with -Recurse, in any order
3: git push with --force or a standalone -f
5: git clean carrying both a force (-f) and a directory (-d) flag
To add a rule needing two things present in any order: (?is)^(?=.*THING_A)(?=.*THING_B) . A plain word also works as a regex on its own.
